high_level_description: The image is a screenshot from the ESPNcricinfo app, displaying the result of the 4th Test match between India and England at The Oval, held from September 2 to 6, 2021, during the India tour of England. The match ended with India winning by 157 runs. Scorecard: India: 191 & 466 (290 & 210) England: 290 & 210 (92.2 overs, target 368) India
